mappingNotes: t_device_tamir records link to already-imported portal contacts by source contact ID. If the device/contact reference is missing, the handover mobile is matched only when unique; otherwise a deterministic repair-customer record is created.

t_request_tamir records link by uniquely normalized mobile to source contacts; ambiguous or missing matches are grouped into deterministic repair-customer records, with source name/mobile/address retained.
Repair type maps source place_tamir company workshop to IN_HOUSE and customer location to ON_SITE; requests with an address map to ON_SITE, otherwise IN_HOUSE.
Only explicit source stages map to target statuses; unknown historical device stages remain REGISTERED and raw IDs/titles remain in provenance.
Source dates are retained raw and parsed from the portal month/day/year 12-hour or English abbreviated-month format into local wall-clock DateTime values.
Source account IDs are preserved only as provenance; portal account IDs are not ERP users, so technicianId and createdById are left null.
Repair request addresses are stored on newly created Customer records; repair notes and history are preserved in case fields and customer activity.
The target updatedAt field is set to the import time, matching the customer/CRM import convention; source history timestamps are retained in activities.
